name: snowball-egg-flight
comment: WP-2.4. A stone wall at x = 4 (y 61-64, z -3..3) on the platform. EntitySnowball(World) (id 0) at (0.5, 62, -1.5) and EntityEgg(World) (harness kind Egg, id 1) at (0.5, 62, 1.5), both with motion (0.5, 0.1, 0) toward the wall; a second snowball (id 2) at (-3.5, 62, 0.5) thrown up and back (-0.2, 0.5, 0) falls onto the platform. Flight: lastTickPos, super.onUpdate, rayTraceBlocks, the entity scan, gravity 0.03 and drag 0.99 (EntitySnowball.java:87-202). On the hit each dies; the egg draws rand.nextInt(8) (and nextInt(32)) for its chickens (EntityEgg.java:156-167). If the oracle hatches a chicken the port, which records EntityChicken.<init> (WP-2.3) after the chicken's Math.random() draws, diverges at the next entity line. rng_state and entity_state every tick.
